--- BEGIN SOURCE: transfer-review.md ---

# Night-bus transfer review: test the timetable at Harbor Junction first

The municipal transport committee reviewed the September transfers from the
last inbound train to the night bus at Harbor Junction. Staff observed
17 missed transfers in the four weeks they logged. In 14 of those cases,
the bus had already left when a train arriving within its published time
reached the platform. Logs for the other three show train delays. The review
covers Harbor Junction only. It did not test whether a schedule change would
improve transfers.

The committee's explicit first trial is to move the last night bus departure
at Harbor Junction five minutes later for two weeks, without changing
departures at other stations. Dispatchers will log completed transfers and
onward delays before the committee decides whether to retain the change.
Better signs were discussed, but the committee set them aside for this
trial. The public briefing should explain the specific mismatch and what the
temporary timetable test will measure.

--- END SOURCE: transfer-review.md ---

idea.title: A two-week, station-specific timetable trial is the committee’s chosen test for missed night‑bus transfers
idea.description: Rather than implementing system-wide changes or immediately altering signage, the committee will run a narrowly scoped, measurable experiment: move the last night‑bus departure at Harbor Junction five minutes later for two weeks (only at that station) and log outcomes before deciding whether to keep the change.
idea.audience: Municipal transport officials, transit planners, local reporters covering transport policy
idea.rationale: This idea highlights a concrete, evidence‑based decision: a short, local operational trial with predefined measurement (dispatcher logs of completed transfers and onward delays). It is useful to readers who follow how public agencies test fixes, because it shows a limited, testable approach that preserves options while collecting data.
idea.evidence: Source states committee's trial: 'move the last night bus departure at Harbor Junction five minutes later for two weeks, without changing departures at other stations.' It adds that 'Dispatchers will log completed transfers and onward delays before the committee decides whether to retain the change.' The source also notes signs were discussed but set aside for this trial.
